port.description: Communication port for the GPS device.

basename.description: Base name for saved files (e.g., gpslog.gpx, gpslog_trk.gpx).

output_tracks.description: Create a GPX file with tracks.

output_waypoints.description: Create a GPX file with waypoints.

output_combined.description: Create a single GPX file with both tracks and waypoints.

logging_mode.description: Turn logging ON or OFF on the device before reading.

full_method.description: Set STOP or OVERLAP recording method on memory full.

log_fields.description: List of fields to enable in the log format.

ignore_errors.description: Ignore some error conditions and try to extract as much data as possible.

write_bad_records.description: Write bad records into the GPX file.

weeks_rollover.description: Add weeks count to timestamps to fix rollover bug.

recover_disabled.description: Recover from disabled log: erase data and reset recording criteria.

read_bin_file.description: Path to a previously saved .bin file to read instead of a device.
